name: @pivotly/clients
description: Every Pivotly client, generated from one contract, one channel manifest and one set of skills. claude is the Claude Code plugin, which also ships a copy of packages/server; codex and gemini run the canonical copy. All three receive the same skills from packages/skills, rendered per host. Adding a client is a data change in the contract plus, if it needs a new config format, one ConfigWriter subclass here.
